fullText.simplified:
第五章、馆长王石先生

    孙林听到有人叫他，低下身子，歪着头看车里面的人，原来是自然博物馆的馆长王石先生。孙林是认识王石先生的。王石先生在西京市绝对是个风云人物，他不仅是一个成功的生意人，还是一个大慈善家。这个博物馆里的东西原本都是王石先生自己的收藏，但是他把整个博物馆变成了公共展馆，免费让市民参观。孙林之前来这里还专门报道了这件事情，他发表了一篇关于王石先生的文章，大受欢迎。在孙林心中，他一直想成为像季平先生和王石先生这样厉害的人。
    “孙记者，好久不见啊。”王石笑着主动和孙林打了招呼。
    “好久不见，好久不见。”孙林很激动地说。
    “孙记者这次来博物馆是想做什么采访呢？”王石问道。
    “听说馆里丢了一只北极熊标本，所以我来看看。如果能帮上忙，帮您找回这只北极熊，当然是更好了。”孙林回答道。
    王石点点头，不急不慢地说道：“博物馆这么大，里面的东西那么多，丢一个两个也是正常的。”
    “那可是北极熊标本啊，难得的宝贝！何况是大型标本，怎么会说丢就丢呢？假如是给人偷走了，您不想抓住这个小偷吗？”孙林说道。
    “这标本珍贵是珍贵，但是我可以再从国外运一只回来，再说我也不缺这些宝贝。你说小偷？那你找到小偷了吗？有人看到小偷吗？你有什么证据吗？”王石看着孙林问道。
    孙林被问住了，他不知道该如何回答王石先生的问题，毕竟他自己也在为证据的事发愁。
    王石扶了扶自己的金边眼镜，接着说：“孙记者，我是来感谢你的。不管是之前你写的关于我的报道，还是你这次来调查北极熊标本的事，我都很感谢。”
    孙林笑了笑，摸了摸脑袋，说：“不客气的，王石先生。只是您不担心博物馆会再丢东西吗？”
    王石微笑着说：“丢东西不但没有影响博物馆的人气，而且让博物馆更有名了。大家觉得这里很神秘，有很多秘密。你看，大家每天都在议论博物馆的事情，每天来这里的人多得不得了，这不好吗？”
    孙林看着王石先生的表情，突然有了一个新的想法：是不是北极熊没有丢，只是给人藏起来了？是不是北极熊自己跑走的故事也是有人故意传出去的？那么这件事情王石先生是知道的，或者说是他安排的？所以王石先生没有报警。这是一种让博物馆更有名的新方法？假如真的是这样，那何小宇看见的事呢？他的反应也不像在说假话啊……
fullText.traditional:
第五章、館長王石先生

    孫林聽到有人叫他，低下身子，歪著頭看車裡面的人，原來是自然博物館的館長王石先生。孫林是認識王石先生的。王石先生在西京市絕對是個風雲人物，他不僅是一個成功的生意人，還是一個大慈善家。這個博物館裡的東西原本都是王石先生自己的收藏，但是他把整個博物館變成了公共展館，免費讓市民參觀。孫林之前來這裡還專門報道了這件事情，他發表了一篇關於王石先生的文章，大受歡迎。在孫林心中，他一直想成為像季平先生和王石先生這樣厲害的人。
    “孫記者，好久不見啊。”王石笑著主動和孫林打了招呼。
    “好久不見，好久不見。”孫林很激動地說。
    “孫記者這次來博物館是想做什麼採訪呢？”王石問道。
    “聽說館裡丟了一隻北極熊標本，所以我來看看。如果能幫上忙，幫您找回這隻北極熊，當然是更好了。”孫林回答道。
    王石點點頭，不急不慢地說道：“博物館這麼大，裡面的東西那麼多，丟一個兩個也是正常的。”
    “那可是北極熊標本啊，難得的寶貝！何況是大型標本，怎麼會說丟就丟呢？假如是給人偷走了，您不想抓住這個小偷嗎？”孫林說道。
    “這標本珍貴是珍貴，但是我可以再從國外運一隻回來，再說我也不缺這些寶貝。你說小偷？那你找到小偷了嗎？有人看到小偷嗎？你有什麼證據嗎？”王石看著孫林問道。
    孫林被問住了，他不知道該如何回答王石先生的問題，畢竟他自己也在為證據的事發愁。
    王石扶了扶自己的金邊眼鏡，接著說：“孫記者，我是來感謝你的。不管是之前你寫的關於我的報道，還是你這次來調查北極熊標本的事，我都很感謝。”
    孫林笑了笑，摸了摸腦袋，說：“不客氣的，王石先生。只是您不擔心博物館會再丟東西嗎？”
    王石微笑著說：“丟東西不但沒有影響博物館的人氣，而且讓博物館更有名了。大家覺得這裡很神秘，有很多秘密。你看，大家每天都在議論博物館的事情，每天來這裡的人多得不得了，這不好嗎？”
    孫林看著王石先生的表情，突然有了一個新的想法：是不是北極熊沒有丟，只是給人藏起來了？是不是北極熊自己跑走的故事也是有人故意傳出去的？那麼這件事情王石先生是知道的，或者說是他安排的？所以王石先生沒有報警。這是一種讓博物館更有名的新方法？假如真的是這樣，那何小宇看見的事呢？他的反應也不像在說假話啊……

sentences.english: Sun Lin looked at Mr. Wang Shi’s expression and suddenly had a new idea:

sentences.simplified: 是不是北极熊没有丢，只是给人藏起来了？
sentences.traditional: 是不是北極熊沒有丟，只是給人藏起來了？
sentences.pinyin: shì bú shì běi jí xióng méi yǒu diū zhǐ shì gěi rén cáng qǐ lái le
sentences.english: Was it possible that the polar bear was not lost but had just been hidden by someone?

sentences.simplified: 是不是北极熊自己跑走的故事也是有人故意传出去的？
sentences.traditional: 是不是北極熊自己跑走的故事也是有人故意傳出去的？
sentences.pinyin: shì bú shì běi jí xióng zì jǐ pǎo zǒu de gù shi yě shì yǒu rén gù yì chuán chū qù de
sentences.english: Was it possible that someone also deliberately spread the story of the polar bear running away by itself?

sentences.simplified: 那么这件事情王石先生是知道的，或者说是他安排的？
sentences.traditional: 那麼這件事情王石先生是知道的，或者說是他安排的？
sentences.pinyin: nà me zhè jiàn shì qing wáng shí xiān sheng shì zhī dào de huò zhě shuō shì tā ān pái de
sentences.english: So, did Mr. Wang Shi know about this matter, or did he arrange it?

sentences.simplified: 所以王石先生没有报警。这是一种让博物馆更有名的新方法？
sentences.traditional: 所以王石先生沒有報警。這是一種讓博物館更有名的新方法？
sentences.pinyin: suǒ yǐ wáng shí xiān sheng méi yǒu bào jǐng zhè shì yì zhǒng ràng bó wù guǎn gèng yǒu míng de xīn fāng fǎ
sentences.english: Therefore, Mr. Wang Shi did not report it to the police. Was this a new way to make the museum more famous?

sentences.simplified: 假如真的是这样，那何小宇看见的事呢？他的反应也不像在说假话啊……
sentences.traditional: 假如真的是這樣，那何小宇看見的事呢？他的反應也不像在說假話啊……
sentences.pinyin: jiǎ rú zhēn de shì zhè yàng nà hé xiǎo yǔ kàn jiàn de shì ne tā de fǎn yìng yě bú xiàng zài shuō jiǎ huà a
sentences.english: If this was really the case, what about what He Xiaoyu saw? His reaction was not like he was telling a lie ...

sentence_translations: Chapter 5: The Museum Director, Mr. Wang Shi
Sun Lin heard someone calling him. He lowered his body and tilted his head to look at the person inside the car.
It turned out to be Mr. Wang Shi, the director of the Natural History Museum. Sun Lin was acquainted with Mr. Wang Shi.
Mr. Wang Shi was certainly an influential figure in Xijing City.
As well as being a successful businessman, he was also a major philanthropist.
Everything in this museum was originally from Mr. Wang Shi’s own collection.
But he turned the entire museum into a public exhibition that was free for city residents to visit.
Sun Lin had previously come to cover this story, and he had published an article about Mr. Wang Shi that was very well received.
In Sun Lin’s mind, he’d always wanted to be as outstanding as Mr. Ji Ping and Mr. Wang Shi.
“Reporter Sun, it’s been a long time.” Wang Shi smiled and went to greet Sun Lin.
“Long time no see, long time no see,” said Sun Lin very excitedly.
“What kind of interview does reporter Sun want to do at the museum this time?” asked Wang Shi.
“I heard that a polar bear specimen was lost in the museum, so I came to check it out.
Of course, it would certainly be even better if I could help you retrieve this polar bear,” Sun Lin replied.
Wang Shi nodded and spoke neither too fast nor too slow:
“The museum is so big, and there are so many items inside. It is normal if one or two get lost.”
“But it was a polar bear specimen, a rare treasure! What’s more, it was a large specimen. How can it just be lost?
If someone had stolen it, wouldn’t you want to catch the thief?” Sun Lin said.
“Sure, this specimen is precious. But I can ship another one back from abroad. Besides, I am not short of these treasures.
Did you say a thief? In that case, did you find the thief? Did anyone see the thief? Do you have any evidence?”
Wang Shi looked at Sun Lin and asked.
Sun Lin was stumped by the question. He didn’t know how to answer Mr. Wang Shi’s question.
After all, he was worried about the issue of evidence himself.
Wang Shi held up his gold-rimmed glasses and continued: “Reporter Sun, I’m here to thank you.
I am very thankful both for the previous story you wrote about me and that you are here this time to investigate the polar bear specimen.”
Sun Lin smiled, rubbed his head, and said, ..
.. “You’re welcome, Mr. Wang Shi. But aren’t you worried that the museum will lose something again?”
Wang Shi smiled and said, “Not only did losing this not affect the popularity of the museum, but it made the museum more famous.
People think this place is very mysterious and has a lot of secrets.
Look, people are talking about the museum every day. So many people come here every day. Isn’t that good?”
Sun Lin looked at Mr. Wang Shi’s expression and suddenly had a new idea:
Was it possible that the polar bear was not lost but had just been hidden by someone?
Was it possible that someone also deliberately spread the story of the polar bear running away by itself?
So, did Mr. Wang Shi know about this matter, or did he arrange it?
Therefore, Mr. Wang Shi did not report it to the police. Was this a new way to make the museum more famous?
If this was really the case, what about what He Xiaoyu saw? His reaction was not like he was telling a lie ...
